name: pg_promise_guard
abstract: Find the guarantees your schema claims and silently stopped enforcing
description: pg_promise_guard reports every guarantee your catalog advertises but no longer enforces — invalid unique indexes, NOT VALID constraints, triggers left disabled after a bulk load, RLS enabled but not forced — telling a live breach apart from a deliberate mid-migration gap. Reads only the system catalogs: no user data, no locks, no shared library.

pg_promise_guard.abstract: Report constraints, indexes, triggers and RLS that stopped being enforced
